sources.title: Duckweed growth model for large-scale applications: Optimizing ...
sources.snippet: Simulations performed using Stella Architect were used to compute annual duckweed yield and generate separate datasets for developing the regression model and optimization model. To improve duckweed yields for large-scale applications which incorporate regular harvesting, a harvesting regime was added to the intrinsic duckweed growth model.
